settings.title: Flat-Fee Nil T2 Filing for Amazon FBA Corporations

settings.editor:
An FBA seller goes quiet differently from a shop. There is no lease to end and nobody to let go, so the corporation carries on with a marketplace account attached to it and a year end arriving every twelve months. Where the year holds nothing, it is $300.00 plus HST per tax year.

Whether the listings were taken down, the account was deactivated, the remaining units were removed or disposed of, or the brand was moved into a different corporation, the year is tested against marketplace sales, disbursements received, reimbursements for lost units and anything the held funds earned. Schedules 100, 125, 141 and 50 are prepared and the return is transmitted electronically. A year with a disbursement in it goes to the full service.

settings.editor:
The pattern here is a seller who stopped paying attention rather than one who closed anything. The corporation stays, the account stays attached to it, and the unfiled years build up quietly.

Each genuinely empty year is $300.00 plus HST per tax year. Where there are several, they are prepared together and transmitted oldest first so the inventory and retained earnings carry through.

settings.html:
The year is nil

  • No order was fulfilled for the corporation in the year
  • No disbursement was paid out to it from the marketplace
  • No reimbursement for lost or damaged units was credited
  • No remaining stock was sold off or liquidated elsewhere
  • Nothing the corporation holds was credited with interest

The year is not nil

  • An order shipped from remaining stock, however few units
  • A disbursement landed in the corporate bank account
  • The platform credited a reimbursement or a refund adjustment
  • Leftover inventory was sold in bulk to a liquidator
  • The brand, the listings or the account itself was sold

Due either way

  • One return per tax year, for as long as the corporation is registered
  • A T183CORP signed off before each of those returns can be transmitted
  • Schedule 50 wherever a shareholding reaches one tenth
  • Any sales tax registration dealt with on its own cycle
  • Clearance ahead of dissolving, which the unfiled years block

settings.title: Marketplace Seller Corporation Filing Across Canada

settings.editor:
Amazon FBA corporations are filed the same way wherever the registered office sits, because the return is prepared and transmitted electronically from end to end. There is nothing to print, nothing to post and nothing to sign in person.

Where the corporation was incorporated changes the registry, not the return. An Ontario corporation answers to the Ontario Business Registry, and corporations in British Columbia, Alberta, Quebec and Saskatchewan each answer to their own. The T2 itself is federal and identical in all of them. Within Ontario, a corporation registered in Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton or Ottawa is filed on the same terms and at the same price as one anywhere else in the country.

Two provinces add a return the federal T2 does not cover. A Quebec corporation also files the CO-17 and an Alberta corporation also files the AT1. Both are separate provincial returns, and neither is included in the $300.00 plus HST fee.
